title: Renegade Immortal: Slaying the Blood Progenitor
native: 仙逆剧场版 弑仙之战
synopsis:
Wang Lin is relentlessly hunted by his sworn enemy in the Thunder Immortal Realm. Pushed to the brink of death, he stages a stunning comeback, overcoming the odds and accomplishing the legendary feat of slaying an Immortal.

(Source: WeTV)

Note: Set between episodes 151 and 152 of Xian Ni.
